snippet.title: Styx: Blades of Greed | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Greed is a powerful motivator… and Styx has plenty of it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3290690

Styx: Blades of Greed is now available, bringing back everyone’s favorite goblin assassin for his most ambitious adventure. Infiltrate big places, outsmart deadly enemies, and master brutal stealth abilities in a dark fantasy world where power is currency.

This time, it’s bigger. More vertical. More dangerous.
And far more rewarding.

Sharpen your blades, embrace the shadows, and get ready to steal what was never meant to be yours.

Styx: Blades of Greed is out now on on PC (Steam & Epic Games Store), PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Follow Styx on X (Twitter) ► https://x.com/StyxVideoGames
